page_title: EIN 4-1 WER | Eintracht Frankfurt v Werder Bremen 23/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Good work from Werder Bremen as they win a corner.
90+5' The current number of shots on goal is 5:5.
90+3' Eintracht Frankfurt control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Horst Steffen has decided to make a change. Isak Hansen-Aaroen (Werder Bremen) replaces Marco Grull.
88' Great teamplay by Eintracht Frankfurt as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
88' 55:45 – this is the current ball possession ratio.

85' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant low shot to the middle of the goal, but is thwarted by a decent save from Michael Zetterer.
83' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Hugo Larsson as he is replaced by Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt).
83' Dino Toppmoller decides to make a substitution. Ritsu Doan will be replaced by Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt).
83' Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
81' Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
78' Substitution. Karim Coulibaly (Werder Bremen) has come on for Niklas Stark.
78' Here is a change. Leonardo Bittencourt is going off and Horst Steffen gives the last tactical orders to Keke Topp (Werder Bremen).
76' Neat passing move from Eintracht Frankfurt in order to create new attacking opportunities.
74' Can Yilmaz Uzun goes off the pitch and Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on.
70' 4 - 1 Goal! Fares Chaibi provides Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom right corner. 4:1.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jonathan Burkardt trots off the pitch and is replaced by Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
67' Dino Toppmoller has decided to substitute Jean-Matteo Bahoya and he is replaced by Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt).
66' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
66' Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Eintracht Frankfurt.
65' We are about to witness a subsitution. Patrice Covic (Werder Bremen) for Samuel Mbangula.
63' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Eintracht Frankfurt.
62' Fouls committed – 4:6.
58' The referee cannot ignore such behaviour. Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) sees a yellow card and needs to watch himself for the rest of the game.
58' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) was quite harsh and Harm Osmers didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
57' The Werder Bremen players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
56' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
54' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
53' Eintracht Frankfurt seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
52' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

50' Werder Bremen players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass. The linesman signals a throw-in for Eintracht Frankfurt.

48' 3 - 1 Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Michael Zetterer is just a bystander as the ball flies into the left side of the goal. The score is 3:1.

47' 3 - 0 Goal Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt)! Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) was put through by Can Yilmaz Uzun and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the right side of the net. 3:0.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
45+1' Eintracht Frankfurt are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Harm Osmers blows his whistle. Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a foul after dangerous play. Werder Bremen get a free kick.
44' Eintracht Frankfurt are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.

42' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.

40' Michael Zetterer makes a good save! Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) easily weaves through the defence and fires in from long range. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
39' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
38' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) meets a cross just outside the area and gets in a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
37' Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) is penalised for a foul. Harm Osmers had a clear view and blows his whistle.
35' Yellow card. Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
34' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
33' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Eintracht Frankfurt for a penalty. Play continues.
32' The current number of shots on goal is 2:2.
30' Werder Bremen enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

28' Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) gets on the end of a cross but produces a tame shot from the edge of the area which goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
26' Eintracht Frankfurt are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes.

25' 2 - 0 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Can Yilmaz Uzun is pounced on by Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt). His close-range strike flashes past Mio Backhaus and into the bottom left corner. 2:0.

22' 1 - 0 Hugo Larsson slides a pass towards Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) who unleashes a fabulous shot from long range. The ball goes behind the surprised goalkeeper and into the top left corner. The score is now 1:0.
21' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
20' Eintracht Frankfurt control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
19' What a big chance! Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball well wide of the left post.

18' An accurate cross picks out Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
16' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Eintracht Frankfurt comes to nothing.
15' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
14' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) takes a long-distance free kick. His shot towards the bottom left corner ends up in the goalkeeper’s hands.
12' Harm Osmers shows a yellow card to Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) for his blatant foul.
11' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging some short passes.
10' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) jumps into a tackle and Harm Osmers signals a foul.
8' Werder Bremen are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
8' The ball possession is 45:55.
5' The corner is swung in but Eintracht Frankfurt can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
3' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
3' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
3' The Eintracht Frankfurt players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
2' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
1' The match has just started.
Werder Bremen will kick the game off.
Harm Osmers will officiate today.
